report:2b6f5c78b7cd4446b93bad45a17d0581.summary: Fix first: Plant within a pet's reach that may be toxic, then Loose cords at floor level a pet can chew - the full ranked list is below. Couldn't check 8 items, including Missing handrail on stairs and No grab bar in bath / by toilet.

hazards.title: Plant within a pet's reach that may be toxic
hazards.description: Small potted plant on low TV stand
hazards.why_it_matters: A pet can easily reach the plant on the low stand and may get sick from nibbling leaves.

hazards.title: Loose cords at floor level a pet can chew
hazards.description: Loose white power cord lying on floor beside TV stand
hazards.why_it_matters: A pet could chew the loose cord on the floor and get shocked or burned.

hazards.title: No light within reach of the bed
hazards.description: Bed with small glass side tables and no lamp or switch within reach of the bed
hazards.why_it_matters: Getting up at night with no light in reach makes a trip or fall more likely.
hazards.verification_reason: Anchor visible and no safety object found where it should be.

hazards.title: Loose cords at floor level a pet can chew
hazards.description: Loose electrical cords on the floor under the desk
hazards.why_it_matters: A pet could chew the live cords lying on the floor under the desk and get shocked.

hazards.title: No fire extinguisher visible in the kitchen
hazards.description: Kitchen with stove and counters visible and no fire extinguisher in sight
hazards.why_it_matters: Without an extinguisher in the kitchen a small cooking fire could spread quickly.
hazards.verification_reason: Not visible, may be stored out of sight.

hazards.title: Things that can burn on or next to the stovetop
hazards.description: Striped towels hanging on oven handle next to stovetop
hazards.why_it_matters: Towels hanging on the oven handle can catch fire from stovetop or oven heat.
hazards.verification_reason: Towels visible in background but SAM missed, needs review

hazards.title: Pet bowls or toys on a walking path
hazards.description: Pet bowls or toys on a walking path
hazards.why_it_matters: Pet bowls or toys on a walking path
hazards.verification_reason: Found by SAM (box) on a room sweep. Pet bowls visible on floor near walkway and seating area

hazards.title: Loose rug or mat on the floor
hazards.description: Small, loose throw rug or mat on a walking area. A large area rug held down by furniture is NOT a finding unless its edges are visibly curled.
hazards.why_it_matters: Small, loose throw rug or mat on a walking area. A large area rug held down by furniture is NOT a finding unless its edges are visibly curled.
hazards.verification_reason: Large area rug under furniture without curled edges, not throw rug.

hazards.title: Loose rug or mat on the floor
hazards.description: Small, loose throw rug or mat on a walking area. A large area rug held down by furniture is NOT a finding unless its edges are visibly curled.
hazards.why_it_matters: Small, loose throw rug or mat on a walking area. A large area rug held down by furniture is NOT a finding unless its edges are visibly curled.
hazards.verification_reason: Large area rug under furniture, no curled edges, not a hazard.

chosen.title: Move it out of reach or remove it
chosen.how: Move the plant somewhere the pet cannot reach, or rehome the plant if it is on a toxic list.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Show the plant moved to a high shelf the pet cannot reach.

plain_language_steps: Pick up the plant from the low TV stand.
Put it up high where your pet cannot reach.
If it can make pets sick, give it a new home.
Pick up any fallen leaves off the floor.

chosen.title: Cord covers or route cords up
chosen.how: Fit cord covers, or route the cords up and along the wall out of chewing range.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Show the cords inside a cord cover running along the wall, off the floor.

plain_language_steps: Unplug the white cord by the TV stand.
Lift the cord up off the floor.
Put a cord cover over the cord.
Run the cord up along the wall out of reach.

chosen.title: Bedside lamp or touch lamp
chosen.how: Put a lamp that is easy to reach and switch on from the bed.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Add a bedside lamp on the nightstand next to the bed.

plain_language_steps: Put a small lamp on the table next to the bed.
Move it so you can reach it from the bed.
Plug it in and turn it on to test.
Practice turning it on and off in the dark.

chosen.title: Cord covers or route cords up
chosen.how: Fit cord covers, or route the cords up and along the wall out of chewing range.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Show the cords inside a cord cover running along the wall, off the floor.

plain_language_steps: Unplug the cords under the desk.
Lift the cords off the floor.
Put covers over the cords.
Run cords up along the wall out of reach.

chosen.title: Mount an extinguisher near the kitchen exit
chosen.how: Place a home fire extinguisher where you can grab it on the way out, not over the stove.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Add a red fire extinguisher mounted on the wall beside the kitchen doorway.

plain_language_steps: Pick a spot by the kitchen exit door.
Get a home fire extinguisher.
Hang it on the wall where you can reach it.
Keep it clear and easy to grab.
Do not put it over the stove.

chosen.title: Keep the stovetop clear
chosen.how: Move towels and paper away from the stovetop.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Show the stovetop completely clear of towels, paper and packaging.

plain_language_steps: Turn off the stove.
Take the towels off the oven handle.
Move the towels far from the stove.
Keep cloth and paper off the stovetop.

chosen.title: Move bowls out of walkways
chosen.how: Move pet bowls and toys out of walking paths.
chosen.visualization_prompt: Show the pet bowls and toys moved out of the walking path.

plain_language_steps: Pick up pet bowls from the walking path.
Pick up pet toys from the walking path.
Put bowls and toys in a corner out of the way.
Check the path each day and keep it clear.

hazards.title: Stove burner left on
hazards.description: Electric cooktop shows lit red heat indicator with a pot on the burner.
hazards.why_it_matters: An active hot burner can cause a serious burn or start a fire if touched or left unattended.

hazards.title: Burnable item on or next to cooktop
hazards.description: Paper towel roll sitting on counter immediately beside the cooktop
hazards.why_it_matters: A paper towel roll that close to a hot cooktop could easily catch fire.

chosen.title: Fix it
chosen.how: Follow the finding's description and make the area safe.

plain_language_steps: Do not touch the hot pot or burner.
Turn the burner knob to off.
Keep people away until the red light goes off.
Let the stove cool down fully.

chosen.title: Fix it
chosen.how: Follow the finding's description and make the area safe.

plain_language_steps: Turn off the cooktop if it is on.
Let the cooktop cool down.
Pick up the paper towel roll.
Put it far away from the stove.
Keep the space by the stove clear.
